text:
Oliver: Quick sync — final pass on company OKR draft. We have a Sales ask (enterprise SLAs) and a Platform ask (Dedicated capacity SLA). Need to decide what’s in COMMITTED vs ASPIRATIONAL. Proposed changes:
• Commit: Latency SLOs (p95 <= 120ms) for Core models
• Aspirational: 50% infra cost reduction via Redwood Optimize
• Defer: public "hosted model access" roadmap item until Q3
If we don't lock today, downstream teams can't scope. 3pm huddle? :clock3:

Jia: +1 on committing latency SLOs but we can't guarantee that tail for arbitrarily long contexts. Can we scope to token cap? e.g., p95 <=120ms for <=8k tokens?

Sarah: Agree with Jia. Also: Sales wants an "enterprise SLA pilot" in Q2. If we commit that, Platform needs to promise capacity/reservations. That's a business-level commitment.

Mike: From infra: Dedicated SLA pilot requires ~2 additional DGX-equivalent nodes (estimate) and putting them into the reserved pool. Ballpark cost delta ~$250k/quarter. Need finance signoff.

Priya: Customer perspective — top 3 enterprise customers asked for model pinning + guaranteed fallbacks. If we mark SLA as stretch, offer an "Enterprise Preview" w/ contractual caveats. That buys time. :ok_hand:

Oliver: Decision proposal: commit latency SLO for core models with a token cap; mark Dedicated SLA as enterprise stretch but add an "enterprise preview" milestone to unblock sales. Move public hosted-model access to backlog (blocked by legal/data policy). Any objections?

Jia: No objections. Wording suggestion for OKR: "Commit: p95 <=120ms for Core-2 model for requests <=8k tokens (hosted). Exceptions documented per incident runbooks."

Sarah: Add acceptance criteria to the OKR: telemetry dashboards, canary rollout plan, and rollback policy. If those are not in place by end of Q1, downgrade to aspiration.

Mike: I'll own infra capacity plan and a precise cost estimate. Will post detailed numbers by EOD (2203145000).

Priya: I'll draft the customer-facing preview comms and a short preview contract template. Target next Tue.

Oliver: Action items recap:
- Mike: infra capacity & cost estimate (EOD)
- Jia: OKR wording + test criteria (tomorrow)
- Priya: preview comms + template (next Tue)
- Sarah: rollout & telemetry checklist (next Wed)
Lock final OKR doc on Friday.

DeployBot: A doc was created: https://docs.redwood.inference/okr/q1-commitments (internal)

Jia: Small wording nit — include "measure: p95 measured on production traffic excluding scheduled maintenance windows" so SRE has clarity.

Sarah: Also add a short acceptance test: run 10k synthetic requests across regions and validate p95 <=120ms under standard load.

Mike: Noted. Will include synthetic load plan in my post.

Priya: I'll coordinate legal on the preview contract caveats; will flag anything that blocks the sales pitch.

Oliver: Sounds good. If nobody raises blockers by EOD, I'll update the draft as discussed and ping for final sign-off. :thumbsup:

Sarah: :+1:

Mike: :+1:

Jia: :+1:

Priya: :+1:
